snippet.title: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
KAWAII OR DIE in this weirdly addictive take on the Tactical FPS + Life Sim genres. (づ•̀⩊•)づ︻╦̵̵̿╤──

Face off in 3v3 multiplayer combat, where fluid movement dominates, and your team of NPC Waifus synergize for 100s of possible builds.

As the manager of a Waifu Mercenary Corp, each victory means new recruits and resources for your Waifu Industrial Complex.
 
Build the ultimate Mother Base, assemble and romance an elite team of kawaii killers, and raid other players to control the near future of 1999.

Pre-Alpha Playtest #1 LIVE NOW at www.steam.wtf.gg

#waifutacticalforce
